package.description: Turn your smartphone into a customizable command and macro pad for your Windows PC over LAN.

en-US.description: Turn your smartphone into a customizable command and macro pad for your Windows PC over LAN.
en-US.longDescription:
MATRIG turns your smartphone into a customizable command and macro pad for your Windows PC.
No dedicated hardware required - just connect your phone and PC to the same Wi-Fi network
and pair them with a QR code or PIN.
Assign anything to buttons: launch apps, run shell commands, send keyboard shortcuts, or
trigger webhooks. Switch button layouts instantly with profiles, automate multi-step
actions with the macro builder, and add widgets such as clocks, timers, weather, and
system monitors.
en-US.name: MATRIG
